error[ZBX-E0224]: can't give the command a terminal
  while  running a command in the container web-1
  cause  opening a pseudo-terminal for the command failed: the kernel returned
         EMFILE
  name   web-1
  pid    502
  step   open_terminal (8 of 33)
  fix    run it without a terminal:   zbx exec web-1 -- <command> < /dev/null
  more   zbx explain E0224
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0224.html
